name: Undimmed Guard
description: Hold a guard in which a small unextinguished glow of will turns away what would put out a lesser flame.

name: Rekindled Blow
description: Strike with will that was nearly out and has caught again so the blow burns hotter than the one before.

name: Fear Burning
description: Burn the fear out of an ally in one hot pass of will and leave the ally clear-headed.

name: Kindling Word
description: Speak a word that lights a flagging ally's will again from a single spark.

name: Unquenched Drive
description: Drive through the foe on a will that has refused every defeat laid on it.

name: Unquenched Mantle
description: Spread a burning mantle over the nearest allies that turns blows and feeds each one the user's refusal to fall.

name: Dread Burnout
description: Burn a heavy dread or a binding of despair out of a company with a long fierce pour of will.

name: Ember Recall
description: Rekindle the last ember in an ally whose breath has just stopped and drag the ally back; the window is short and every use is a heavy consequence.

name: Undimmed Recoil
description: Swallow a ruinous blow into the undimmed will and loose it again in a stroke that matches it.

name: Unbowed Aura
description: Stand in the full crush of a mighty aura and cancel its hold on the user and the allies close at hand.

name: Quenchless Surge
description: Surge at a foe with a will that cannot be put out and weigh down the foe's will where the blow lands.

name: Quenchless Heart
description: Cast the whole unquenched heart outward in one burst that breaks the foe's line and floods the allies with the same fire at a strength set by the user's reserve.

name: Willfall
description: Bring the whole weight of the unquenched will down over a field of foes in a stroke of ruin that reaches the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Deathless Vow
description: Swear the deathless vow over a whole company and hold a shield of will over it as wide as the ceiling of its tier allows.

name: Sovereign Poise
description: Hold a poise so complete that the blows of a battle seem to arrange themselves around the user.

name: Crowned Blow
description: Strike with the settled authority of a will that rules itself and need not hurry.

name: Fear Dissolving
description: Dissolve fear in an ally by the plain presence of an unafraid will beside the ally.

name: Royal Word
description: Speak a word of command that sets an ally's will upright without argument.

name: Sovereign Drive
description: Drive forward with every ounce of the will at the user's command and none of it wasted.

name: Crowned Mantle
description: Raise a regal mantle of will over the allies in reach that turns the blow and lends the allies the user's composure.

name: Crown Weight
description: Lay the weight of a ruling will on a foe and slow every move of the foe's body and mind.

name: Sovereign Revival
description: Command a falling ally's heart to continue by the authority of a ruling will; the window is short and every use is a heavy consequence.

name: Sovereign Recoil
description: Take the full measure of a ruinous blow into the ruling will and return it at the striker without a flicker of strain.

name: Crown Unbowed
description: Refuse the command of a mightier will so entirely that the command has no hold on the user or the allies near.

name: Dominion Surge
description: Surge through a hostile line on a ruling will and bow the wills of those struck.

name: Sovereign Standard
description: Plant the standard of a ruling will above the company so that it stands unbroken at a depth set by the user's reserve.

name: Crowned Heart
description: Loose the crowned heart in one commanding blow that bows the foe's will at a weight set by the user's reserve.

name: Crownfall
description: Let the whole ruling will fall on a battlefield and break every hostile stance within the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Crown Unyielding
description: Hold an unyielding crown of will over an entire host that no force below the ceiling of its tier can bend.
